dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: The blazing sun blessed our great Alliance and set us upon our purpose: To scour the world with flame. To burn away every impurity, every wicked thing that dares stand between humankind and its rightful destiny.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: Yes, I know what the traitors of later ages claim. They shattered the Alliance, raised mortals up as new suns, and branded the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame as a tyrant. Let them speak.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: The blazing sun has never died. One day the true god will return. Fire will sweep across this corrupted age, and the earth itself will be made pure again. And when that day comes, those trapped here will not perish... they will be reborn into the hope that awaits them.
